7 Brew Brewchata Chai Latte: Price, Calories & Recipe

A medium Brewchata Chai Latte is about $4.65, with 230 calories, 16 mg of caffeine and 48 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Calories, caffeine and sugar are from the official guide. Prices are researched estimates for a tea or chai and vary by market.

Is there a sugar-free Brewchata Chai Latte?

Yes — 7 Brew lists a sugar-free version built with sugar-free syrups. Comparing mediums (iced):

VersionCaloriesSugarCarbsCaffeine
Brewchata Chai Latte23048 g49 g16 mg
Sugar-free Brewchata Chai Latte15027 g28 g16 mg

Caffeine does not change — only the syrup does. See every sugar-free option in the customization guide.

Every sugar-free swap on the menu, compared side by side, lives on our sugar-free drinks page.

Brewchata Chai Latte allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists Almond for the Brewchata Chai Latte. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Brewchata Chai Latte

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Brewchata Chai Latte?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Brewchata Chai Latte at Home (Copycat Recipe)

Build the chai latte first, then add the two syrups in equal parts. That 50/50 split is the whole Brewchata idea: brown sugar cinnamon for the horchata warmth, vanilla to round it out.

For one medium Brewchata Chai Latte

  • 6 oz spiced chai concentrate
  • 6 oz milk (almond milk is the fan favorite for this one)
  • 1/2 oz brown sugar cinnamon syrup
  • 1/2 oz vanilla syrup
  • A full cup of ice for the iced version
  1. Stir the two syrups into the chai concentrate.
  2. Add the milk and pour over ice, or steam everything together for hot.
  3. Dust with cinnamon if you like. It is the horchata finish.

Chiller version: blend the same build with the ice instead of pouring over it. That is the separate Brewchata Chai on the menu (260 calories for a medium per the guide, a little richer than the latte). Strawberry version: add 1/2 oz strawberry syrup, the fan build that fills the search suggestions.

7 Brew Brewchata Chai Latte FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Brewchata Chai Latte?

A medium iced Brewchata Chai Latte has 230 calories. A small has 170 and a large 280, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Brewchata Chai Latte?

16 mg in a medium iced. The figures on fan sites (10 mg in a small, 16 in a medium, 22 in a large) are not invented. They are the guide's own numbers. Hot runs 18 mg in a medium and the frozen Brewchata Chai is 25. This page printed 0 mg until October 28, 2026, and that was the error.

How much does a 7 Brew Brewchata Chai Latte cost?

Roughly $3.95 for a small, $4.65 for a medium and $5.45 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Brewchata Chai Latte?

48 g in a medium, or 27 g if you order the sugar-free version.

What is a Brewchata?

A chai latte dressed up like horchata. The name is a mash-up of 7 Brew and horchata, and the official build is right on the menu: brown sugar cinnamon plus vanilla in a chai latte, equal parts of the two syrups. Fans often order it with almond milk for the horchata feel, and if a stand does not know the name, the fallback order is 'a chai latte with almond milk, brown sugar cinnamon and vanilla.' It is a regular menu item, not a secret one, despite what some posts claim.

Brewchata Chai Latte vs Brewchata Chai: are they the same?

No, and the guide lists them separately. The Brewchata Chai Latte is the iced or hot latte: a medium iced is 230 calories and 48 g of sugar. The Brewchata Chai is a frozen chiller, blended: a medium is 260 calories and 60 g of sugar. If your drink arrives blended, you got the chiller.

How much caffeine is in a Brewchata Chai Latte?

16 mg in a medium iced, per the official guide: 10 in a small, 22 in a large, 18 hot in a medium and 25 as a frozen chiller. The sugar-free version carries the same caffeine. Chai is black-tea based, so expect a gentle lift, far below the coffee drinks, but not zero. Add espresso (a dirty Brewchata) if you want real caffeine, and then it counts like coffee.

Is there a strawberry Brewchata?

Yes, as a fan build. Strawberry Brewchata shows up constantly in search suggestions: it is this drink with strawberry syrup added. It is not a separate line in the official guide, so there are no official numbers for it. Order it as a Brewchata with strawberry and you will get it.

How do I make a Brewchata at home?

Start with the chai latte (equal parts chai concentrate and milk), then stir in 1/2 oz brown sugar cinnamon syrup and 1/2 oz vanilla syrup. Almond milk gets you closest to the horchata idea. The full copycat recipe is in the recipe section on this page.
